## Walkthrough Parameterize TLS lookup in ObservedConfig with a per-target `servingInfoPath`, add authentication-related test targets (ObservedConfig, ConfigMap, service, deployment, ClusterOperator), update tests to read TLS fields via the configured path, and adjust HyperShift ConfigMap skip logic. ## Changes **TLS ObservedConfig authentication extension** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**servingInfoPath field in observedConfigTarget**
`test/extended/tls/tls_observed_config.go`|`observedConfigTarget` gains `servingInfoPath` (defaults to `["servingInfo"]`) and `observedConfigTargets` entries are updated to set it explicitly (e.g., `openshift-authentication-operator` → `oauthServer.servingInfo`).| |**Authentication-related test targets**
`test/extended/tls/tls_observed_config.go`|Adds `openshift-authentication-operator` to `configMapTargets`; extends `serviceTargets` and `deploymentRolloutTargets` with authentication components (marked management-cluster); adds `authentication` to ClusterOperator stability waits.| |**Remove HyperShift skips for management cluster ConfigMap checks**
`test/extended/tls/tls_observed_config.go`|Per-namespace ConfigMap TLS injection and disruptive ConfigMap restoration test cases no longer skip `managementClusterComponent` targets on HyperShift in the shown invocations.| |**Update verification to use servingInfoPath**
`test/extended/tls/tls_observed_config.go`|`testObservedConfig` and `verifyObservedConfigForTargets` now extract/assert `minTLSVersion` and `cipherSuites` from `spec.observedConfig` at each target's configured `servingInfoPath` rather than assuming a top-level `servingInfo`.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - [openshift/origin#31194](https://github.com/openshift/origin/pull/31194): Related HyperShift/management-cluster handling and ObservedConfig verification changes. - [openshift/origin#31160](https://github.com/openshift/origin/pull/31160): Related refactor of TLS observed-config test targets and reading logic. ## Suggested labels `lgtm`, `verified` ## Suggested reviewers - kaleemsiddiqu
